A consolidated revenue stream to support instruction at non-district schools. This is a combination of what has historically been Student-Based Budgeting (SBB) and Supplemental Aid. There are now two rates - one for Elementary School Level Students, and one for High School Level Students

FY2026 budgets for charter schools reflect a change in methodology to align with continued increases in CPS’s ISBE-certified per capita tuition charge. This single, consolidated funding stream provides adequate financial resources for Charter Schools in line with the Illinois School Code. Estimates are based on projected funding for FY2026.
